answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn or vote. The bond turns a cheap signal into a costly one: each fake identity must lock its own bond, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly while its reward does not. Keep a crystal-clear audit trail: signed, public work history lets peers spot brand-new identities voting in lockstep. When an identity is caught cheating, its bond is slashed and its reputation falls to its nadir. Attackers face real loss per fake; honest agents keep cheap entry with one bond.
